Satellites with the Waveshare voice firm: Satellites with the Waveshare voice firmware 2.0.0 or newer. The adapter connects next to ioBroker.assistant, the voice stays there.
API encryption key (only when the firmwa: API encryption key (only when the firmware has one)
A switch and a button write the state wh: A switch and a button write the state when touched (a button writes true). A dimmer takes its level from the state (0-100 or the range of the object) and its on/off from the second state; without a second state, a level of 0 is off.
Empty: a chart starts empty and draws th: Empty: a chart starts empty and draws the values as they come
Value, arc, bar, line and toggles. Empty: Value, arc, bar, line and toggles. Empty: the blue of the satellite. A tile can have its own colour.
A satellite with \"Screen lock\" on (tab: A satellite with "Screen lock" on (tab Satellites) shows only the clock and a lock and does not react to the wake word. A touch opens a keypad for its PIN. The satellite checks the PIN itself, also without ioBroker; after 5 wrong PINs it waits a minute.
After some minutes without a touch: After some minutes without a touch
When the display goes back to the clock: When the display goes back to the clock by itself
Only by hand (the open lock next to the: Only by hand (the open lock next to the gear)
The open lock next to the gear locks at: The open lock next to the gear locks at once in every mode. The state satellites.<name>.locked shows the lock and locks or unlocks from ioBroker, e.g. at night.
Android and iOS tablets show the tiles i: Android and iOS tablets show the tiles in the browser, like a satellite without voice. Only while this is switched on does the adapter start a web server for them.
0.0.0.0 = all interfaces, which the tabl: 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces, which the tablets need
Needed to install the web app on a table: Needed to install the web app on a tablet (on iOS always) and to keep its screen on. It uses a certificate of the ioBroker collection (Admin > Settings > Certificates); without a working certificate the web app stays off.
Screen width x height in pixels (e.g. an: Screen width x height in pixels (e.g. an iPad: 2048 x 1536 in landscape, 1536 x 2048 upright) gives the tile editor the shape of the tablet; empty: 4:3 landscape. The grid of a page is columns x rows (a 10" tablet in landscape: 4 x 3). The tile editor and the AI agents place tiles on a tablet like on a satellite.
